description: S459 LOW-MED-3: a union with a refined member is judged member by member, so every member needs a runtime test. A map whose values are refined (`[string: number(>0)]`) would need every entry judged, which the union judge cannot express, so the annotation is refused at the declaration with E-CONTRACT-002 — it is not compiled to a check that admits every map (before the fix the member judged `true`, so `@m = -5` was admitted too).
rationale: §53.11: "The compiler SHALL emit a runtime check for every boundary-zone assignment that it cannot statically elide"; a check the compiler cannot write is refused rather than admitted (the E-CONTRACT-002 "cannot be judged" sense, §53.11).
